section.title: Products
section.para: Independent coverage has generally described Collibra's products as a set of enterprise tools for finding, understanding, governing, and controlling data across distributed environments. While the company's early identity was closely tied to governance and catalog functions, later coverage emphasized a broader product set that combined governance with data quality, analytics-adjacent tooling, policy controls, and AI-governance capabilities.

At a high level, Collibra's product coverage in independent reporting spans data catalog and governance, data quality, analytics-oriented notebook tooling, data lineage and metadata management through acquired capabilities, and AI governance.

row.entry: Organizing, governing, and controlling enterprise data assets.
